title: Looking Up URLs in the Zscaler Admin Console

blocks.text: In the Zscaler Admin Console, you have the ability to see how Zscaler categorizes a site according to its URL or IP address. Since a single IP address is capable of running multiple hosts or applications, Zscaler does not typically place IP addresses into the predefined URL categories. However, if a SaaS or cloud provider dedicates an IP address or IP range to an application, the Zscaler service categorizes it. For example, 13.107.6.152/31 is used for Microsoft 365 and is categorized as Professional Services and Microsoft 365. To learn more about URL categories, see About URL Categories.
You can also look up URLs from Zscaler's Site Review website. To learn more, see Looking Up URLs in Site Review.

blocks.item: From the navigation menu, go to Internet Access > Resources > URL Lookup.
Enter the URL and click Lookup URL.

blocks.text: The service displays the following information:

blocks.item: URL: The URL you are looking up.
URL Classifications: The predefined category or super category of the URL.
Security Alert: The security alert associated with the URL.
Cloud Application: The cloud application category and cloud application with which the URL is associated.
